doc.title: Tom Malone interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 3, 2023

title: Turning down Frank Sinatra for another job
summary: Malone says he has played with everybody but Sinatra, whom he had to refuse for a prior booking; professionalism matters.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: So I thought what we would do is list every gig you’ve ever played and every person you’ve ever played with and then six hours later I’ll ask my first question.

Well I played with everybody except Frank Sinatra. And I got a call to play with him in Atlantic City from Joe Malin, his string contractor/concertmaster, and I already had another job so I had to turn down Frank Sinatra. Can you believe that?
So my career went right downhill right there, that day.
That says something about your professionalism.
Well you know you have to do the right thing. Word gets around quickly in the business.
